_comment: Hand-curated exceptions where a prime part's ducat value doesn't follow the standard drop-rarity formula (Common=15, Uncommon=45, Rare=100, mixed=25/65). Mirrors the Warframe Wiki's Module:Void/data DUCAT_EXCEPTIONS table (fetched 2026-09-24 from https://wiki.warframe.com/api.php?action=parse&page=Module:Void/data). Keys in `exceptions` are lowercased full item+part display names, matching WfcdItem.name after component-name derivation. Update by re-fetching the same wiki module if new exceptions are added upstream.
